title: Kubernetes Namespace + RBAC to AWS IAM Migration
description: Migrate K8s RBAC (ServiceAccounts, ClusterRoles, RoleBindings) to EKS IRSA (IAM Roles for Service Accounts).

steps.action: Export K8s RBAC: kubectl get serviceaccount,clusterrole,clusterrolebinding,rolebinding -A -o yaml > k8s-rbac.yaml
steps.verify: YAML file contains all service accounts and role bindings; review for over-privileged roles

steps.action: Enable OIDC provider for EKS cluster: eksctl utils associate-iam-oidc-provider --cluster analytics-eks --approve
steps.verify: aws iam list-open-id-connect-providers shows EKS OIDC provider ARN

steps.action: Create IAM roles for each K8s ServiceAccount: eksctl create iamserviceaccount --name <sa-name> --namespace <ns> --cluster analytics-eks --attach-policy-arn <arn> --approve
steps.verify: kubectl get serviceaccount <sa-name> -n <ns> -o yaml shows eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn annotation

steps.action: Update pod specs to use IRSA service accounts; remove explicit AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID env vars from manifests
steps.verify: kubectl exec <pod> -- aws sts get-caller-identity returns IRSA role ARN; no hardcoded credentials in env
steps.rollback: Revert service account references in pod specs
